description: Ministry of Justice - The Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No. 02 of 2013 Notification Under Substation (5) Section 7
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the parliamentary approval of an order extending the period of operation of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 2013. This content deals specifically with legal/regulatory matters - the extension of an existing law's operational period - which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a Minister being assigned the subject of Justice, this is contextual information about who made the order, not the primary focus of the gazette content, which is the legal extension of the Act's operation.
